name: txpool_status
summary: Returns how many transactions the pool is holding.
description: Returns the number of transactions eligible for the next block (`pending`) and the number held back because their nonce leaves a gap (`queued`). Both are plain integers, not hex quantities.

result.name: status
result.description: The pending and queued transaction counts

pending.title: pending
pending.description: Transactions eligible for the next block

queued.title: queued
queued.description: Transactions whose nonce leaves a gap and cannot be executed yet
